articles.title: Preamble to the NAPS LASUSTECH Constitution

sections.title: Solemn Resolution
sections.content: "We, the undergraduate and postgraduate students of the National Association of Physics Students (NAPS), Lagos State University of Science and Technology (LASUSTECH) Chapter, having firmly and solemnly resolved to promote the highest standards of scientific inquiry, theoretical physics, experimental excellence, and moral integrity; to foster solidarity, protect student rights, ensure equitable academic welfare, and advance technological progress in Nigeria, do hereby enact and give to ourselves this Constitution."

articles.title: Name, Motto and Supremacy of the Constitution

sections.title: Section 1: Official Name
sections.content: The Association shall be officially recognized and designated as the NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF PHYSICS STUDENTS (NAPS), LAGOS STATE UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY (LASUSTECH) CHAPTER.

sections.title: Section 2: The Motto
sections.content: The official motto of the Association shall be "Empowering Minds, Exploring the Cosmos" and "Advancing Science, Unlocking the Universe".

sections.title: Section 3: Scope of Physical Sciences
sections.content: Under this Constitution, Physics encompasses: Theoretical Physics, Applied Geophysics, Radiation & Health Physics, Condensed Matter Physics, Electronics & Instrumentation, Renewable Energy Science, Computational Physics, and Astronomy.

sections.title: Section 1: Scientific & Academic Growth
sections.content: To organize academic tutorials, symposia, laboratory safety workshops, and industrial excursions that enrich students' understanding of physical sciences and prepare them for postgraduate and industrial careers.

sections.title: Section 2: Student Welfare & Research Support
sections.content: To maintain an accessible past question bank, advocate for adequate laboratory equipment, and provide welfare assistance to indigent physics scholars.

sections.title: Section 1: Ordinary Membership
sections.content: All matriculated students enrolled in the Department of Physics / Physical Sciences at LASUSTECH are de facto ordinary members of NAPS.

sections.title: Section 2: Annual Departmental Dues
sections.content: Every student shall pay a mandatory annual chapter due of Two Thousand Naira (₦2,000) per academic session, entitling them to the official Digital Student ID Card, exam clearance slips, voting rights, and access to all chapter facilities.

sections.title: Section 1: Executive Offices
sections.content: The executive officers of the chapter shall comprise: The President, Vice President, Lady Vice-President, General Secretary, Assistant General Secretary, Financial Secretary, Treasurer, Director of Academics, Welfare Director, Public Relations Officer, Social Director, and Sports Director.

sections.title: Section 2: Tenure
sections.content: All executive officers shall hold office for a single academic session of two semesters.
